definition: A $2 \times 2$ matrix $A$ that moves each point $\boldsymbol{x}$ of the plane to its image $A\boldsymbol{x}$ (plus a translation vector $\boldsymbol{b}$ if there is one), such as a stretch, an enlargement, a rotation about the origin or a reflection in a line through the origin; $\lvert\det A\rvert$ is its area scale factor.
A shape made by applying the same transformations again and again for ever, so it shows detail at every scale; its length or area at each stage often forms a geometric sequence.
